# Rahul Chanda Photography

> Commercial and product photographer based in Dehradun, India. Specializing in product, food & beverage, footwear, and brand campaign photography with in-house retouching. On-location service across Uttarakhand and pan-India travel.

## About

- Site: https://rahulchandaphotography.com/
- Founded: 2019
- Based in: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India
- Service area: Dehradun, Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar, and pan-India with travel
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Services

- [Product Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services/product-photography): E-commerce packshots, Amazon/Flipkart/Shopify-ready product imagery, cosmetics, watches, jewelry, D2C brands.
- [Food & Beverage Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services/food-beverage-photography): Restaurant, cafe, cloud kitchen, menu, delivery apps (Swiggy/Zomato), beverage splash, food styling.
- [Footwear Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services/footwear-photography): Shoe and sneaker e-commerce angle sequences, footwear catalog photography, leather goods detail macros, marketplace-ready white-background packshots.
- [Fashion Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services/fashion-photography): On-model lookbooks, editorial campaigns, apparel e-commerce imagery, boutique and designer brand stories, model coordination and creative direction.
- [Commercial Campaign Photography](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/services/commercial-campaigns): Brand campaigns, advertising photography, billboards, digital ads, brand launches.

## Local Pages

- [Dehradun](https://rahulchandaphotography.com/dehradun): On-location commercial photography across Dehradun neighborhoods (Rajpur Road, IT Park, Mussoorie, Rishikesh, Haridwar) and Delhi NCR.
